long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: My hunger has run out, and the bowl is where food is kept, even if it is not much.
I will sit next to the bowl until something is put in it, and I will look like I did not come for the food.
Once I have eaten, I will return to the high place and keep an eye on the beach.

today.reason: Hunger has hit zero, so I am putting the bowl first, then returning to my high place.
